name: How long does mold remediation in air vents typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does mold remediation in air vents typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of mold remediation depends on the severity and location of the mold. A localized issue might be resolved in a day, while extensive mold growth throughout the entire HVAC system or within inaccessible areas could take several days to a week or more. This includes time for inspection, containment, removal, cleaning, drying, and final verification. Your chosen professional can provide a more accurate timeline after their initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold remediation time varies from a day for minor issues to several days for extensive mold, depending on severity and location.
